Name: Ner, Son of Abiel
Summary: Ner, son of Abiel and brother of Kish, was the father of Abner, commander of Saul's army.
KeyStory: Ner fathered the man who would hold Saul's kingdom together after Saul's death.
RelatedPeople: Abner, Son of Ner; Kish, Son of Abiel
LifeLesson: Behind every commander stands a father whose name is barely remembered.
